items.headline: Anthropic updates its Usage Policy, effective November 12
items.summary: Anthropic's new Usage Policy adds a clear ban on fake accounts, fabricated news sites and hidden-origin promotional campaigns, tightens rules on covert tracking and weapons, and requires a human reviewer for high-risk uses like health, finance and legal decisions. Most everyday use is unchanged.
items.why_it_matters: If you use Claude to run social accounts or marketing, make sure your content is clearly yours and not part of a network of fake or disguised accounts. Otherwise nothing changes for normal use.

opportunity.action_note: Skim the updated Usage Policy before November 12 and check that any Claude-powered marketing or social workflows don't involve fake or disguised accounts.
